en: 9 Dhammayamaka 9.1 Paṇṇattivāra 9.1.2.
Exposition of the Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāraniddesa)
9.1.2.1. Chapter on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanavāra) 9.1.2.1.1.
Direct Order (Anuloma) Are wholesome states wholesome? Yes.
Are wholesome states wholesome? Yes.
Are unwholesome states unwholesome states? Yes.
Are unwholesome states unwholesome? Yes.
Are indeterminate states indeterminate? Yes.
Are indeterminate states [called] "indeterminate"? Yes.
9.1.2.1.2. Negative (Paccanīka).
Are they neither wholesome nor unwholesome states? Yes. Are states that are not wholesome not wholesome? Yes.
Are they neither unwholesome nor unwholesome states? Yes.
Are unwholesome states not unwholesome? Yes.
Are indeterminate states not indeterminate states? Yes.
Are indeterminate states not indeterminate? Yes.
9.1.2.2. The Wheel-Section on the Root of Purifying the Categories (Padasodhanamūlacakkavāra) 9.1.2.2.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma) Are wholesome states wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are all phenomena unwholesome phenomena?
Unwholesome phenomena are both phenomena and unwholesome phenomena; the remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.
Are all wholesome phenomena wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are indeterminate phenomena (dhammā) "indeterminate phenomena"?
Indeterminate phenomena are both phenomena and indeterminate phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena.
Are unwholesome phenomena "unwholesome phenomena"? Yes.
Are all phenomena wholesome phenomena?
Wholesome phenomena are both phenomena and wholesome phenomena; the remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.
Are unwholesome [phenomena] unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are indeterminate phenomena (dhammā) indeterminate states (abyākatā dhammā)?
Indeterminate phenomena are both phenomena and indeterminate states. The remaining phenomena are not indeterminate states.
Are indeterminate [states] indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are all phenomena (dhammā) wholesome phenomena (kusalā dhammā)?
Wholesome phenomena are both phenomena and wholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.
Are all indeterminate (abyākata) phenomena indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are phenomena unwholesome phenomena?
Unwholesome phenomena are both phenomena and unwholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.
9.1.2.2.2. Negative (Paccanīka)
Are they not wholesome, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not phenomena, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not wholesome, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not phenomena, yet not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are they not unwholesome, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not phenomena, yet not wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not unwholesome, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not phenomena, yet not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are they not indeterminate, yet not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are they not phenomena, yet not wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not indeterminate, yet not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are they not phenomena, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
9.1.2.3. Section on Pure Phenomena (Suddhadhammavāra) 9.1.2.3.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma) Are they wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are phenomena (dhammā) wholesome phenomena (kusalā dhammā)?
Wholesome phenomena are both phenomena and wholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.
Are they unwholesome phenomena (akusalā dhammā)? Yes.
Are phenomena unwholesome phenomena?
Unwholesome phenomena are both phenomena and unwholesome phenomena; the remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.
Are they indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are indeterminate phenomena (dhammas) [the same as] phenomena?
Indeterminate phenomena are both phenomena and indeterminate phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena.
9.1.2.3.2. Negative (Paccanīka).
Are they not wholesome and not phenomena?

With the exception of the wholesome, the remaining phenomena are not wholesome, yet they are phenomena. With the exception of both the wholesome and phenomena, the remainder are neither wholesome nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena and not wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not unwholesome and not phenomena?

With the exception of the unwholesome, all remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena. With the exception of both the unwholesome and phenomena, all remaining things are neither unwholesome nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena and not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not indeterminate and not phenomena?

With the exception of the indeterminate, the remaining phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena. With the exception of both the indeterminate and phenomena, the remainder are neither indeterminate nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena and not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.

Positive Order (Anuloma) Are they wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are phenomena unwholesome phenomena?
Unwholesome phenomena are both phenomena and unwholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.
Are they wholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are indeterminate states (dhammas) "indeterminate states"?
Indeterminate states are both states and indeterminate states. The remaining states are not indeterminate states.
Are they unwholesome states? Yes.
Are phenomena (dhammā) wholesome phenomena (kusalā dhammā)?
Wholesome phenomena are both phenomena and wholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.
Are they unwholesome phenomena (akusalā dhammā)? Yes.
Are indeterminate phenomena (dhammā) "indeterminate phenomena"?
Indeterminate phenomena are both phenomena and indeterminate phenomena. All remaining phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena.
Are they indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are all phenomena (dhammā) wholesome phenomena (kusalā dhammā)?
Wholesome phenomena are both phenomena and wholesome phenomena; the remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena.
Are they indeterminate phenomena (abyākatā dhammā)? Yes.
Are phenomena unwholesome phenomena?
Unwholesome phenomena are both phenomena and unwholesome phenomena. The remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena.
9.1.2.4.2. Negative (Paccanīka)
Are they not wholesome, yet not phenomena?

With the exception of the wholesome, all remaining phenomena are not wholesome phenomena. With the exception of both the wholesome and phenomena, all remaining things are neither wholesome nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena, yet not unwholesome phenomena? Yes.
Are they not wholesome and not phenomena?

With the exception of the wholesome, all remaining phenomena are "not wholesome phenomena. With the exception of both the wholesome and phenomena, all remaining things are neither wholesome nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena and not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.

With the exception of the unwholesome, all remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena. With the exception of both the unwholesome and phenomena, all remaining things are neither unwholesome nor phenomena.

With the exception of the unwholesome, the remaining phenomena are not unwholesome phenomena. With the exception of both the unwholesome and phenomena, the remainder are neither unwholesome nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena and not indeterminate phenomena? Yes.
Are they not indeterminate and not phenomena?

With the exception of the indeterminate, the remaining phenomena are not indeterminate phenomena. With the exception of both the indeterminate and phenomena, the remainder are neither indeterminate nor phenomena.
Are they not phenomena and not wholesome phenomena? Yes.
